exclusion_reason: The console EDRAM tile-resolve prototype is implemented: it models the tile address function, resolves a tiled framebuffer back into the linear layout a WebGPU texture samples, and round-trips a tiled fixture provably, and it reports the WebGPU copy-region resolve mapping. This is prototype-only ([P4]) and the feasibility verdict is prototype-backed. The benchmark remains red because measuring the resolve on the declared live adapter set does not run in the gate.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the report and prototype resolve a research tile fixture on the declared adapter set.
expected_failing_assertion: The tile resolve is measured bit-exact on the declared live adapter set.
active_gate_evidence: The shader suite proves the tile-resolve prototype round-trips a tiled framebuffer to linear, reports the WebGPU resolve mapping, and refuses an invalid framebuffer.
procedure: Prototype the tile resolve over the research fixture.
Measure on the declared adapter set.
Record the feasibility verdict with evidence.
pass_criterion: The prototype resolves the tile fixture.
